title: Game Engines
concept: Building game engines with XIOM — entity-component systems, rendering pipelines, physics integration, and the game loop pattern.
why: Game development pushes systems programming to its limits. XIOM's performance, safety, and low-level control make it ideal for game engines and real-time applications.
tips: ECS separates data (components) from behavior (systems) — clean, cache-friendly, composable
Fixed timestep for physics, variable timestep for rendering — prevents physics glitches at different frame rates
Object pooling reduces allocation — pre-allocate bullets, particles, enemies
Profile early — games hit performance limits quickly, know where your frame time goes
common_mistakes: Physics at variable timestep — causes inconsistent behavior and tunneling
Not capping delta_time — a lag spike shouldn't teleport entities
Putting logic in components — components are DATA, systems are LOGIC
